name: 45219 · Cincinnati, OH
findings: ZIP 45219 (Cincinnati) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45219 (Cincinnati) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 4 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 16 would.
